app_fee.value: The application fee is CAD 120, non-refundable, paid by Visa or Mastercard.
app_fee.quote: The non-refundable application fee of $120 CAD can be paid by Visa or Mastercard.

also.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $120 (Canadian) payable to Queen's University must accompany each application

fee_waiver.value: The graduate school's pages describe the fee as non-refundable and mention no fee waiver.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE rule; some programs require it, so check the program record.
gre_general.quote: Some programs require satisfactory achievement on the GRE. | Please check with the degree program for specific testing needed and scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT average of 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale, with section minimums of Writing 5, Speaking 4, Reading 4.5 and Listening 4.5. The 2026-27 calendar still lists the old-scale minimum of 88 (W24/S22/R22/L20).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (Test of English as a Foreign Language Internet-based Test). Average overall score of 4.5. | Applicants must have the minimum score in each section.

also.quote: TOEFL Internet-based Test (TOEFL iBT): The minimum overall score is 88, made up of the minimum scores in each component test

ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic (International English Language Testing System) - 7 (minimum overall score)

english_waiver.value: You can request an exemption only if, in the 12 months before the month you apply, you completed at least one full year at a post-secondary institution taught in English; the transcript or an official institution letter must confirm English-medium instruction. An older Indian degree does not qualify, and a request is not normally considered if you already hold a valid passing score or failed an accepted test.
english_waiver.quote: Any applicant whose first language is not English, but who, within the 12-month period prior to the month of application, has studied for at least one complete year at a post-secondary institution where English is the official language of instruction, may submit with their application a request to be exempted from the English language proficiency test requirement. | If it is not stated on or evident from the transcript that English is the language of instruction, the applicant must make arrangements for a separate, official letter that confirms this to be sent to the SGSPA from the issuing post-secondary institution.

notes: All full-time PhD students in years 1-4 get a guaranteed minimum funding package (CAD 25,000/yr in 2026-27) if they request financial support on the application. International PhD students pay domestic tuition.
